name: narrator
title: Narrator
description: Writes what other plugins found in a video as a timeline of plain sentences: who said what, how (loud, quiet, the emotion of the voice), how their face looked, what moved and what was in view. No model of any kind: the same findings always give the same text.

narrate.description: Joins the findings of other plugins by time and writes one line for each sentence (or each turn when there are no sentences), and one for each movement or thing in view while nobody speaks. Give each list as its plugin gives it; every list is optional.
narrate.title: Narrate

sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.description: What was said: the sentences of speech-to-text (startMs, endMs, text).

turns.title: Turns
turns.description: Who spoke when: the turns of speakers (startMs, endMs, label).

tones.title: Voice tones
tones.description: How it was said: the segments of voice-tone (startMs, endMs, loudness, emotion, emotionConfidence).

expressions.title: Face expressions
expressions.description: How the faces looked: the expressions of face-emotion (startMs, endMs, face, label, confidence).

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: What moved: the movements of movement (startMs, endMs, label).

scenes.title: In view
scenes.description: What was in view: the appearances of visual-phrases (phrase) or coco-objects (class), with startMs and endMs.

minConfidence.title: Least confidence
minConfidence.description: An emotion of a voice or an expression of a face less sure than this is not written (default 0.5).

answerWithinMs.title: Answer within
answerWithinMs.description: How soon after another person's question a line counts as its answer (default 3000).

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The narration, one line for each thing said or happening, in the order they start.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: Who speaks in the line, as the narration names them; null for a line of what happened while nobody spoke.

text.title: Narration
text.description: The lines one after another, a line each.

people.title: People
people.description: Each speaker: speaker (the label of the turns), name (as the narration calls them: a name given, or Person A, Person B...) and face (the face of face-emotion taken for theirs, or null).

failures.description: A param is wrong, or an item of a list lacks startMs, endMs or the field the narrator reads.
